messages:
sophia: Quick sync — thinking about a 'soft-lease' primitive for prefix sharing. Goal: let remote nodes hold a transient soft lease that reduces eviction aggressiveness while still allowing fast takeover. Sketch below.

sophia: Motivation: hot tenants get unfairly squeezed by slab-level evictions. Full lease handoff is heavy. Soft lease = ephemeral grace window + local penalty score.

kai: hmm. how is this different than current 'soft-pin' + eviction credits?

sophia: soft-pin is binary; soft-lease is time-decayed weight that influences allocator. It's additive and commutative across nodes so no strict fencing.

mike: risk: split-brain where two nodes both think they have soft-lease and prefer keeping data => memory blowup

sophia: agreed. safety model: max_concurrent_soft_lease_per_prefix = 2 and global_mem_budget check. Also eviction-score multiplier decays exponentially: score *= exp(-t/half_life)

nina: can you paste a config example?

sophia: ```
soft_lease:
  enabled: true
  ttl_ms: 30000
  half_life_ms: 10000
  max_sharing: 2
  budget_ratio: 0.2  # percent of node mem for shared soft-lease
```

kai: metrics to validate? eviction_latency_by_prefix, soft_lease_holders_count, soft_lease_memory_fraction, takeover_failures

mike: also need telemetry for 'evict_delta' when soft-lease expires; ensure no sudden IO spike

nina: how about fallback: if memory pressure > threshold, immediately convert soft-lease holders to demote-only (no prefill)

sophia: yep, fallback policy noted. Canary plan: enable on single shard, watch(30m) for eviction_rate and P99 read latency.

runtime-bot: deploy plan created: canary -> rollups at 10% -> 50% -> 100% (owners: @sophia @kai)

dan: one more nit: use jitter on ttl to avoid synchronized expiry storm

sophia: good call — add jitter +/- 15%

kai: lgtm. we should write a short RFC with invariants (memory bound, takeover liveness) and a failure-mode playbook

sophia: I'll draft RFC + small sim test. Pinging infra for perf regression signoff. :eyes:

mike: thanks. quick question — does this change the ownership contract? i.e., can soft-lease holder accept writes?

sophia: no writes. read-only prefill only. full ownership still requires lease handshake. keeps correctness simpler.

nina: ok thanks. putting this on next eng-arch sync agenda :calendar:

kai: :thumbsup:
